title: Azusawa Kohane — Accepting It All〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Weekend Garage
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I'll need to do my best again today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, Kohane, you're here pretty early.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hi, Shinonome! I didn't realize you were already here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I was just having a quick practice with Ken.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: By the way... You seem to be in an oddly good mood.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Y-You think so?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Yes, it certainly seems that way at first glance. Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
I ran into the owner of Crawl Green just now and...
Several dozen minutes earlier
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I left early in order to get in some practice this morning, but I got here a lot earlier than I was expecting...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I know I shouldn't impose, but I'll see if I can use Weekend Garage...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Shinonome and Aoyagi both did their parts, so I want to make sure their efforts don't go to waste...!)

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Hm? You're...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh...!
You're the owner of Crawl Green!

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to run into you here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, me neither.
Umm, it's been a little while.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
Yes, it has.
But more importantly...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Would you mind telling Shinonome that he put on a very nice performance the other day?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
He really lit up the place that day.
It's hard to believe that he'd improved so much after not seeing him for a little while...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Your team just keeps finding new ways to surprise everyone.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you for saying that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But... We've got even bigger surprises in store!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We've made the commitment to surpass RAD WEEKEND, and we're practicing accordingly.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, just wait...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: I see. That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: I'm so glad An chose you to be her partner.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: I know we're not in any position to be saying this, but we've always seen her as family...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: As family...?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: When she was struggling to find a suitable partner, I kept hoping that someone good would eventually come along.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
Which is why I'm glad you appeared.
You're strong, honest, an incredible singer and a pillar of support for An as she chases her dream.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: So, Azusawa, thank you for becoming her partner.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... U-Umm...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(What do I say...?
I wasn't expecting to hear such kind words...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I wasn't expecting to... But I feel so happy...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm also glad that I got to become An's partner.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Meeting An led to me having my own dream to pursue. It also allowed me to meet everyone on Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, I really can't thank her enough...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: That's wonderful to hear.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You and the owner talked about all that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. Being thanked like that caught me off guard a little, but it also made me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: To be fair, I understand how he feels.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Before meeting you, An had to endure quite a lot in her search for a good partner...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right. She was so talented that she could show up most other teams all on her own.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I see...
Which means she's always been really amazing at what she does.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: However, as a result, she ended up struggling to find a compatible partner...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: She struggled so much that all the locals began helping her look for one. They'd tip her off about any good singers they heard about.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I can't lie. After a while, it started feeling like we were looking for her future spouse.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I can see how it'd turn into that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (She searched all over the place for a suitable partner, and she ended up choosing me...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Plus, all the locals have started saying that they're glad she did.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So, I need to keep doing my best...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And show that I'm proud to be An's partner...!)
